STEAM PIPELINE WORKS: listing https://steamcommunity.com/app/<appid>/screenshots/?p=N&browsefilter=toprated gives sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=NNN links. Sample Elden Ring original: 3840x1608 JPEG, 6.97 bits/px = high quality, NOT recompressed. But ultrawide -> reject per §6. Must filter aspect ~16:9.
